content: समाह्वयः .²1 Calling out, challenging. .²2 War, battle. .²3 A single combat. .²4 Setting animals to fight for sport, betting with living creatures; एष एव विधिर्ज्ञेयः प्राणिद्यूते समाह्वये <ls>Y. 2. 203</ls>; <ls>Ms. 9. 221</ls>. .²5 A name, an appellation; तस्मात्ते वर्तयिष्यामि तयोरेव समाह्वयम् <ls>Mb. 14. 21. 13</ls>.
